description: Reviewed per-listing quote-unit exceptions, applied before the generic exchange/market/suffix rules in _system/scripts/listing_units.py. A listing belongs here only when its venue's default currency or minor-unit scale is wrong for this specific security. New exceptions must include a reason and review date.

PSH.reason: Pershing Square Holdings is LSE-listed but its ordinary shares are quoted and reported in USD, not pence. The LSE default (GBP, minor_unit_factor 100) would be wrong in both symbol and scale.
